title.narrative: Strengthening preventive nutrition, services for the most vulnerable groups in Gujba LGA, Yobe state

description.narrative: ltpgtThe ‘strengthening of preventive nutrition services for the most vulnerable groups in Gujba LGA, Yobe state’ project seeks to improve the well-being of vulnerable populations by increasing access to quality nutrition services while building community resilience and reinforcing local systems for sustainable impact. It will majorly target vulnerable communities in Gujba LGA, including women (caregivers, pregnant and breastfeeding women girls), adolescent girls and boys, and children under five who are affected by acute malnutrition, heightened risks of gender-based violence, and protection breaches.ltbrgtThe project will be led by the Community Nutrition Mobilizers, who will conduct routine community sensitization and door-to-door active case finding to identify and refer SAM cases to existing Outpatient Therapeutic Programmes (OTPs) and Stabilization Centers for appropriate care. The project will also provide Tom Brown to support children (aged 6-59 months) detected with Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM). 108 Support groups (Mother-to-Mother and Father-to-Father Support Groups) will be established and strengthened as a platform for sharing experiences and offering psychosocial support to participants, as well as coordinated efforts to promote Maternal, Infant, and Young Child Nutrition (MIYCN) counseling services alongside the provision of supplementary nutrition assistance for pregnant and breastfeeding women and girls. Community stakeholders will be equipped on Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) practices, the use of Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) tapes to strengthen local capacity for accurate screening, timely detection, and appropriate referral of SAM cases as well as sensitized on GBV and PSEA. Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA) will be provided to caregivers to support access to treatment and project adherence.ltbrgtProtection is integrated into the project to focus on strengthening community-awareness and sensitization on Gender Based Violence and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA). ltbrgtlt/pgt
